messages:
emma: Heads-up, docusaurus staging deploy failing with a flurry of broken fragment links after the localization pass. saw 404s for anchors like `#konzept` on /docs/overview
jack: can you paste the exact error from the linkcheck job?
emma: from nightly-log:
```
ERROR: 404 http://staging.redwood/docs/overview/#konzept
WARN: Broken references found in /docs/getting-started/setup.md -> 'overview/#konzept'
```
priya: i dug in 10mins. Docusaurus slugifier preserved a trailing punctuation in the German headings (e.g., "Konzept:") turning the anchor into `konzept%3A` in one place and `konzept` in another depending on whether it passed through our markdown pipeline. mismatch = broken jump.
leo: ouch. is this the same as the mkdocs Unicode-hyphen issue we saw last month?
priya: similar class, but here it's punctuation-encoding + redirect rules. we have a mix of raw markdown sources and some generated MDX that get processed differently.
emma: short-term fix: i replaced the problematic links in /docs/getting-started/setup.md to point to `/docs/overview/#konzept%3A` and reran linkcheck. that unblocked the build. not ideal.
jack: we should normalize anchors at build-time and add a compatibility redirect rule so both `konzept` and `konzept%3A` resolve. can someone draft the smallest patch?
priya: i'll add a small post-processing step in docs-build that URL-decodes/encodes anchors consistently and also strips trailing punctuation for canonical anchor generation. plan: generate a map of original_heading -> canonical_slug and emit a small JSON used by the server redirector.
leo: while you're at it, can we add a one-off fixer script to rewrite existing intra-doc links in the repo? a sed approach might be fastest for the immediate sweep. example i used locally:
```
# replace hrefs that miss the colon-encoded anchor
git grep -l "overview#konzept" | xargs sed -i "s/overview#konzept\b/overview#konzept%3A/g"
```
emma: please avoid brittle sed for localized content. prefer a python AST approach that only touches markdown link targets.
priya: will do python. prototype:
```
from urllib.parse import quote
for file in md_files:
    replace links where anchor exists and missing trailing punctuation -> quote(anchor)
```
jack: add test cases for en, de, and fr headings (some languages include punctuation in headings more often).
docs-bot: docs CI: linkcheck failed for branch fix/anchor-normalize. See https://ci.internal.redwood/2020 for logs.
priya: updated PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/501 includes anchor normalizer, a small compatibility redirect map, and unit tests for localized headings. also added migration note to docs/MIGRATION.md about re-running `tools/regen-anchors.py` after editing headings.
leo: reviewed, left minor comment on the redirect mapping format. requested tweak: add TTL comment.
emma: after merge please run the site deploy with the new redirect map. i'll run a quick integration check on staging.
jack: approved and merged. nightly deploy kicked. :rocket:
docs-bot: nightly build succeeded with anchor compatibility plugin enabled. all stale linkcheck warnings cleared.
priya: follow-up task: DOCS-237 "sweep for encoded anchor inconsistencies" created. assigning to docs team rotation.
emma: thanks everyone. small doc note: add a line to the SDK snippets guide explaining how to reference anchors from client-side apps (encode anchors with `encodeURIComponent`).
leo: noted; adding short example in /docs/guides/sdk-snippets.md:
```
const anchor = encodeURIComponent('Konzept:');
fetch(`/docs/overview/#${anchor}`)
```
